findings.claim: The goal radiogroup has no accessible name equal to its visible label.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/components/onboarding-goal-field.component.tsx:23-30 renders the visible FormLabel and RadioGroup, but the group has no aria-label or aria-labelledby. The shared FormLabel htmlFor targets the group id, which does not label a div role=radiogroup. INSPECTED.
findings.fix: Associate the visible label with the RadioGroup through aria-labelledby or an equivalent accessible-name relation, then add a role query for the group name.

findings.claim: The test named for units-first order cannot fail when units are moved below the narrative.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/components/onboarding-form.component.spec.tsx:225-232 only checks presence by test ID. Moving the units field below the narrative and running npx vitest run src/app/modules/onboarding/components/onboarding-form.component.spec.tsx stayed GREEN: 25 tests passed. MECHANIZED.
findings.fix: Assert DOM order, including the units field before the first numbered section and before numeric fields.

findings.claim: The stage report claims a completed-submit-until-redirect test that does not exist.
findings.evidence: .stage-report.md:40,52 names showsBuildingPlanSurfaceAfterCompleteUntilRedirect, but frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/components/onboarding-form.component.spec.tsx:389-394 only checks that the overlay appears after completion. It does not test guard redirect timing or unmount behavior. INSPECTED.
findings.fix: Correct the report and add a test that verifies the completed surface remains until the redirect guard unmounts the route.

findings.claim: Complete-success idempotency nonrotation is not covered by the frontend tests.
findings.evidence: The invariant is specified at docs/specs/slice-5-onboarding/spec.md:356, while the completed test at frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/components/onboarding-form.component.spec.tsx:389-394 checks only overlay presence. Adding setIdempotencyKey(crypto.randomUUID()) to the complete branch left the narrow form suite GREEN with 25 tests passed. MECHANIZED.
findings.fix: Add a terminal-success test that captures the first key and proves a subsequent submit on the mounted form does not rotate it.

findings.claim: The 422 test does not prove that all entered values survive the rejection.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/components/onboarding-form.component.spec.tsx:206-222 asserts only the narrative value and submit state. Injecting form.setValue('typicalWeekly','41') in the catch path left the narrow form suite GREEN with 25 tests passed. MECHANIZED.
findings.fix: Enter distinct values across required and optional fields and assert every value after the handled 422 before retry.

findings.claim: Fresh UUID uniqueness per form mount is not tested.
findings.evidence: The source initializes the key at frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/components/onboarding-form.component.tsx:57-61, but the existing test at :280-287 checks only UUID shape. Replacing the initializer with a fixed valid UUID left the narrow form suite GREEN with 25 tests passed. MECHANIZED.
findings.fix: Mount two independent forms or remount one form and assert their initial request keys differ.

findings.claim: The legacy missing-narrative hydration case has no frontend test.
findings.evidence: The implementation uses the required fallback at frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/schemas/onboarding-form.schema.ts:408-417, but the seeded fixtures at frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/schemas/onboarding-form.schema.spec.ts:342-389 and page fixture at :162-192 both provide narrative. The spec edge case requires missing narrative to hydrate as empty. INSPECTED.
findings.fix: Add a DTO fixture without narrative and assert hydrateOnboardingFormFields returns narrative ''.

findings.claim: The page identity test does not prove Wordmark is mounted first.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/pages/onboarding.page.tsx:186-194 places Wordmark before the header, but frontend/src/app/modules/onboarding/pages/onboarding.page.spec.tsx:150-160 checks only presence and classes. Moving Wordmark after the header would keep that test green. INSPECTED.
findings.fix: Assert the Wordmark DOM node precedes the page header or first form gate child.
